Prior administrative, program, or project coordination experience within an academic, research, or healthcare setting.
Experience in OB/GYN.
Prior experience handling Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions and research project coordination.
Duties include, but are not limited to:
Manage day-to-day administrative operations, process implementation, and ongoing communication across program partners and six UC sites.
Coordinate inter-campus meetings, collaborative activities, and research questionnaires under the direction of two Principal Investigators.
Assist with Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions and ensure smooth project workflows across participating locations.
Support data sharing and administrative tasks within Epic and MyChart to facilitate collaborative program goals without direct patient contact.
Familiarity with electronic health record platforms, specifically Epic and MyChart, for administrative and data tracking purposes.
Working knowledge of REDCap for data management, entry, and survey administration.
Strong organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multi-site activities across flexible work hours.
Demonstrated ability to adapt to expanding program needs and transition effectively between part-time and full-time responsibilities.
